Title: Construction Site Emission Management Ontology
Description: XEMO is an ontology for the semantic representation of construction-site pollutant emission monitoring and management. It provides a shared structure for connecting construction-site organisation, emission sources, pollutants, sensors, observations, and thresholds, supporting the development of interoperable Semantic Digital Twin applications.
Reference: Bruttini, A., Hagedorn, P., Getuli, V., Capone, P., and König, M. (2026). XEMO: Construction Site Emission Management Ontology for Particulate Matter. EG-ICE 2026.
